published.source: Report re-sim on master abd7cd3, 2026-10-16: no level-based partial resist (#102) and the pass 23 rotations (#98 to #105) (was 673.8)

summary: Sinister Strike with Seal Fate from Assassination and Blade Flurry from Combat.
rotation: Uses the Combat Swords rotation (no Adrenaline Rush talent, so that line is skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 5 combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5s), or at 79+ energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
notes: Spec family set to Assassination (30 Assassination points); the PR frames it as a variant of Combat Swords and it uses the rogue_combat mksettings setup and the Combat Swords APL. The talent preset tooltip mentions Hack and Slash, but the talent string has no Hack and Slash point.
